status: questions and scoring criteria frozen before new study inference

design.schedule: question-major; policy order rotates by question index; fixed in manifest before inference

policies.legacy: Current VideoAgent adaptive policy, native response schema; no event-output adapter or post-hoc citation-to-onset conversion.
policies.research: ResearchAgent with hybrid retrieval, CPU visual index/OCR, claim audit and event refinement.
policies.no-refinement: Same ResearchAgent and resources with refine_events=False. Actual trajectories may differ; no-refinement is not forced matched evidence.

controls.additional_modality_controls: Run in separate outputs and label access regimes explicitly. Transcript-only must remove captions, visual index and frame inspection; selecting retrieval-only is insufficient.

reasoning_scoring.source: Prewritten claim atoms with required supports; named external reviewer annotations, never the answering model audit as ground truth.
reasoning_scoring.unknown: Null accuracy with explicit unknown counts and lower/upper bounds.
reasoning_scoring.strict_success: Every required atom correct, every claimed relation correct, and additional claims supported; evidence support scored separately.
reasoning_scoring.independence: Assistant audit is neither independent human validation nor blind unless an actual masked protocol is recorded.

event_scoring.prediction_source: Explicit result.event only, no regex extraction from prose or citation starts.
event_scoring.uncertainty: Point distance to reference bracket; both predicted endpoints must fit tolerated reference bracket.
event_scoring.wide_brackets: Reference containment alone is not success; report bracket widths and worst endpoint error.
event_scoring.denominator: All onset cases, including missing, errors, abstention and wrong occurrence. Error means are conditional on valid same-modality predictions and include out-of-scope wrong occurrences.

reference_domains.transcript: ASR cue spans, not independently aligned spoken-word onsets.
reference_domains.visual: Locally refined complete-title legibility transition; not global first appearance, not animation completion.

event_scoring.legacy_limitation: Legacy native schema has no explicit event output. Its onset score assesses absent interface capability, not a fair content-only localization comparison. Research vs no-refinement is the comparable explicit-event ablation.

support_geometry.meaning: Geometry only; does not verify entailment or full continuous observation.

limits: One user-supplied42m55s video; no cross-video generalization estimate.
Diagnostic questions include reformulations of earlier inspected examples, not untouched held-out benchmark cases.
Two transcript onset cases intentionally reuse the same utterance at different occurrences; correlated control pair.
Visual reference supports for onset are narrow transition brackets; citation-IoU is secondary and can penalize otherwise useful surrounding context.
Refinement, extra planning and auditing may alter actual generations and latency; equal ceilings do not imply equal computational cost.
preservation: Original52-run study and subsequent temporal regressions remain separate and unchanged.

definitions.retrieval: Candidates follow chronological search calls and returned rank; duplicate physical regions are removed. Recall@k is the maximum one-to-one fraction of required supports matched in the first k unique candidates. A hit requires compatible known modality and either an actual sampled timestamp in the reference interval or interval IoU>=0.3. These are localization diagnostics, not semantic correctness.
definitions.reciprocal_rank: Inverse rank of the first candidate matching any required support; zero for a recorded search with no relevant hit. Questions without required supports or without a recorded search have null retrieval metrics.
definitions.ndcg_at_5: Binary unique-support gain, discounted by log2(rank+1). At most one previously unmatched support earns gain for each candidate (highest geometric score breaks ambiguity); ideal DCG contains min(5, number of required supports) gains. Repeated evidence for the same support cannot increase gain.
definitions.citation_geometry: Unique final citation intervals with known/inferred-from-ledger modality are matched to required supports at interval IoU>=0.3. Precision counts matching citations divided by unique valid citations plus invalid citations. Support recall uses one-to-one assignment. Unknown modality earns no modality-qualified credit; temporal-only precision is reported separately. Neither is entailment or event-onset accuracy.
definitions.cost: Only observed finite nonnegative telemetry contributes. Missing fields remain null. Latency quantiles use linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; every distribution reports measured and missing counts. Counts include failed tool attempts where recorded.
definitions.duplicate_frames: (decoded frame count - unique sampled timestamp count) / decoded frame count, only when both counts are observed and consistent. Zero decoded frames and zero unique samples yield zero. Unobserved timestamps do not imply all frames were unique.
definitions.rates: Operational error and abstention rates use non-missing predictions as their denominator. Tool failure rates use attempts with known ok/error outcomes. Format repair requires an explicitly classified format/validation rejection followed by another decision; unclassified errors leave that rate unknown. Decision-repair counts are reported separately.
definitions.budget: Hard limits are at most four attempted tools (or a stricter configured limit) and the configured frame limit, default 16. Reported counts are checked against trace counts; the larger tool count is used. Unknown telemetry cannot establish budget compliance.
definitions.joint_reviewed: Reasoning joint success requires a complete named semantic review, supported correct required/extra claims, and all required geometric supports. Event joint success requires an explicit boolean event-identity review and an explicit within-scope, modality-compatible timing prediction. Unreviewed quality remains null; citation times are never substituted for event predictions.

diagnostic_metrics.unknown_values: JSON null / CSV unknown; never imputed as zero
